entry.title: Custom PO header field value not available in BAdI MMPUR_PO_WORKFLOW_RESTART
entry.content:
Description:

We have created a custom field on the Purchase Order header and are populating it during PO creation using BAdI implementation MM_PUR_S4_PO_MODIFY_HEADER. This value is then read back in BAdI implementation MMPUR_PO_WORKFLOW_RESTART to drive our workflow restart logic.

 

  • When the PO is created via transaction ME21N, the custom field value set in MM_PUR_S4_PO_MODIFY_HEADER  is correctly available when read in MMPUR_PO_WORKFLOW_RESTART .        
  • When the same PO is created via the "Manage Purchase Orders" Fiori app, the custom field is correctly set and saved by MM_PUR_S4_PO_MODIFY_HEADER (value is visible on the saved PO) , but when MMPUR_PO_WORKFLOW_RESTART is triggered, the field value is returned as 0 instead of the value set .

 

Please advise on the correct approach/note (if any) to ensure the custom field value is consistently available in MMPUR_PO_WORKFLOW_RESTART regardless of whether the PO is created via ME21N or the Manage Purchase Orders Fiori app.

entry.title: SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition – J1IG STO BAdI: GR Validation and Reference Number Change Not Work
entry.content:
Hello Experts,

We have a requirement in SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition related to the India GST STO process.

Application:

Create Inbound Invoices for STOs – India (J1IG / J_1IG_INV)

We are using:

  • BAdI: BADI_J_1IG_STO_CLOUD

  • Method: CHANGE_BEFORE_POST

  • Custom Implementation: YY1_STO_CLOUD

We have two requirements, but currently neither requirement is working as expected.

Requirement 1 – Block J1IG if GRN is not posted

J1IG should not allow creation/posting of the inbound GST invoice/FI vendor document if the STO PO does not have a valid Goods Receipt.

Expected behavior:

STO PO → GR 101 → J1IG Inbound GST Invoice

If Movement Type 101 has not been posted, J1IG should stop the process with an error.

Also, if 101 was posted and completely reversed by 102, it should not be considered a valid GR.

We attempted to implement this validation in:

BADI_J_1IG_STO_CLOUD → CHANGE_BEFORE_POST

However, J1IG is still proceeding even when the required GR has not been posted.

Requirement 2 – Change J1IG Reference Number

Currently, when we click Create Inbound GST Invoice in J1IG, the Reference Number is automatically populated with the ODN / GST Sequence Number.

Current:

Reference Number = ODN / GST Sequence Number

Required:

Reference Number = STO Outbound Billing Document Number

The required billing document is the STO Billing – GST Out. Inv. document.

We attempted to change this using:

BADI_J_1IG_STO_CLOUD → CHANGE_BEFORE_POST

However, the ODN number is still being populated and the STO billing document number is not appearing.

Our question

Could an SAP expert please advise:

  1. Is BADI_J_1IG_STO_CLOUD / CHANGE_BEFORE_POST the correct BAdI to implement both requirements?

  2. How can we check for a valid 101 GR not completely reversed by 102 in SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition?

  3. How can we stop J1IG posting from this BAdI when GR is missing?

  4. Which exact field/structure controls the J1IG Reference Number?

  5. Is there another released BAdI/API required to replace the ODN with the STO billing document number?

  6. Is the Reference Number overwritten by standard J1IG processing after CHANGE_BEFORE_POST?

We are looking for a released/clean-core solution for SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition.

We can provide our current YY1_STO_CLOUD implementation and screenshots if required.

Thank you.

entry.title: EML MODIFY on another sales order from SD_SLS_* BAdI — BEHAVIOR_ILLEGAL_STATEMENT
entry.content:
S/4HANA 2025, developer extensibility (clean core).

I need to update the quantity of a sales document (a contract, doc type ZCON) via EML when another sales order (child order) that references it — by Customer Reference (VBKD-BSTKD) — is saved.

The update logic itself works: in a standalone class (if_oo_adt_classrun), READ + MODIFY ENTITIES OF I_SalesOrderTP (field RequestedQuantity) + COMMIT ENTITIES runs fine and the value persists, no locks.

The problem is doing it from within the child order's save flow. I don't own the sales order BO, so I hook in via BAdI SD_SLS_CHECK_BEFORE_SAVE (enhancement spot ES_SD_SLS_EXTEND). Two attempts:

  • Without COMMIT ENTITIES: the MODIFY ENTITIES is silently ignored — the contract is not updated. The syntax checker also warns that the statement violates the FUNCTIONAL transactional contract.
  • With COMMIT ENTITIES: runtime dump BEHAVIOR_ILLEGAL_STATEMENT, and the child order is not saved.

So updating the contract from inside the check BAdI is clearly not the way. What is the clean-core pattern to trigger a post-commit update of the contract from a sales order save? Options I'm considering: BGPF (Background Processing Framework), a RAP business event via a container BO, or an Application Job.

Which is the recommended approach for this scenario?

Thanks!

entry.title: AUTHORITY-CHECK returns values not maintained in Business Role – SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition
entry.content:
We are working on the FG (Finished Goods) screen in SAP Public Cloud, where we need to control authorization based on different fields and operations.

One of the fields in the FG screen is a Shift dropdown. This dropdown has 3 possible values:

  • DAY – Day Shift
  • NGT – Night Shift
  • GEN – General Shift

The requirement is that the user should only be authorized for the Shift values that are maintained in their Business Role.

For example, suppose a Business Role has the following authorization:

Application: FG
Operation: 0010
Shift: GEN

In this case, when the user accesses the FG screen, the expected authorization should be:

  • GEN → Authorized
  • DAY → Not Authorized
  • NGT → Not Authorized

Technically, we have created a Global Authorization Class for performing the authorization checks, a Field-Level Authorization Class for checking authorization for individual fields, and a Behavior Implementation Class that calls these authorization methods and returns the result to the FG screen.

The issue we are facing is with the actual authorization check.

During debugging, we are checking each Shift value separately. For example:

GEN → AUTHORITY-CHECK → sy-subrc = 0 → Authorized

This is correct because GEN is assigned in the Business Role.

But when we check:

DAY → AUTHORITY-CHECK → sy-subrc = 0 → Authorized

and

NGT → AUTHORITY-CHECK → sy-subrc = 0 → Authorized

These are also returning authorized, even though DAY and NGT were not assigned in the Business Role.

We also tested the standard AUTHORITY-CHECK directly during debugging, without using our authorization wrapper method. Even there, DAY and NGT are returning:

sy-subrc = 0

So it does not appear to be an issue with our wrapper logic or with assigning rv_ok = X.

We are seeing the same type of behavior with some of the other authorization fields as well: values that are not explicitly maintained in the Business Role are still passing the authorization check.

1.Global class -   METHOD can_work_on.

  IF iv_inchg IS NOT INITIAL

     AND iv_machine IS NOT INITIAL

     AND iv_biltyp IS NOT INITIAL.

    AUTHORITY-CHECK OBJECT 'ZPP_PRDEXE'

      ID 'ZPPAPP'   FIELD iv_app

      ID 'ZPPOPER'  FIELD iv_oper

      ID 'ZPPSHIFT' FIELD iv_shift

      ID 'ZPPINCHG' FIELD iv_inchg

      ID 'ZPPMACH'  FIELD iv_machine

      ID 'ZPPBLTYP' FIELD iv_biltyp.

  ELSE.

 

    AUTHORITY-CHECK OBJECT 'ZPP_PRDEXE'

      ID 'ZPPAPP'   FIELD iv_app

      ID 'ZPPOPER'  FIELD iv_oper

      ID 'ZPPSHIFT' FIELD iv_shift

      ID 'ZPPINCHG' DUMMY

      ID 'ZPPMACH'  DUMMY

      ID 'ZPPBLTYP' DUMMY.

  ENDIF.

  rv_ok = xsdbool( sy-subrc = 0 ).

ENDMETHOD.

 

2.Behaviour Class - DATA(lv_gen_auth) = zcl_pp_auth=>can_work_on(

        iv_app   = zcl_pp_auth=>app-fg_pipes

        iv_oper  = lv_operation

        iv_shift = 'GEN' ).

      DATA(lv_day_auth) = zcl_pp_auth=>can_work_on(

        iv_app   = zcl_pp_auth=>app-fg_pipes

        iv_oper  = lv_operation

        iv_shift = 'DAY' ).

      DATA(lv_ngt_auth) = zcl_pp_auth=>can_work_on(

        iv_app   = zcl_pp_auth=>app-fg_pipes

        iv_oper  = lv_operation

        iv_shift = 'NGT' ).

      ls_result-ShiftGeneralAuth = lv_gen_auth.

      ls_result-ShiftDayAuth     = lv_day_auth.

      ls_result-ShiftNightAuth   = lv_ngt_auth.

entry.title: S/4HANA OData V2 Services Returning HTTP 403 – CSRF Token Validation Failed
entry.content:
Hi Experts,

We are currently facing an issue while accessing S/4HANA OData V2 services from our SAP UI5 applications.

OData Services: Multiple OData V2 services in QRE
Failure Date: 28 September 2026
Approximate Time: From start of day

The applications and OData services were functioning as expected previously. However, from today, requests involving POST / $batch are consistently failing with HTTP 403 Forbidden – CSRF token validation failed.

This issue is not limited to deployment. Existing UI5 applications that were already working are also experiencing the same issue while communicating with the S/4HANA OData V2 services.

Technical Details:

The application successfully fetches the CSRF token using the X-CSRF-Token: Fetch header.

The S/4HANA backend responds successfully with HTTP 200 OK and returns an X-CSRF-Token.

The token returned by the backend is then included in the subsequent request.

However, the subsequent $batch POST request fails with HTTP 403 Forbidden – CSRF token validation failed.

Example request:

POST /sap/opu/odata/sap/<ODATA_SERVICE>/$batch

We have verified from the browser network trace that:

  1. The $batch request is nevertheless rejected with HTTP 403.

Observation:

This issue started suddenly, while the same applications and services were working previously.

The issue is also occurring with multiple existing OData V2 services/applications, so it does not appear to be specific to a particular UI5 application or a new deployment.

We would like to understand whether there have been any recent changes related to:

  • S/4HANA Gateway

  • Any recent system configuration or maintenance

Request your guidance on the possible root cause.

Screenshots of the $batch request/response

Can you please help on this issue.

Thank you.

entry.title: How to Expose Parameterized CDS Views as an OData Service in SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud RAP for Fiori

entry.title: Alternative Approach for Mass Upload of Recurring Journal Entry Templates in SAP S/4HANA Public Clou
entry.content:
Hello Experts,

I am looking for guidance on a requirement in SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud related to the creation of recurring journal entries at scale.

Business Requirement

We need to mass create/upload a large number of recurring journal entry templates in the system. The objective is to avoid manual creation of each recurring journal entry through the Fiori application Manage Recurring Journal Entries app (F1598)  due to the high volume involved.

After reviewing the available standard applications and APIs, we have encountered the following limitations:

  1. The Manage Recurring Journal Entries Fiori application does not appear to provide any standard Excel upload / mass upload capability for creating recurring journal entries.

  2. The application is based on the OData service/API: FAC_RECURRING_ACCOUNTING_DOC_SRV However, this service appears to be an unreleased API and therefore cannot be consumed for custom development or integrations in SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud, where only released APIs are supported.


Could the community please suggest a supported approach in SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud for:

A. Mass creation of recurring journal entries

B. Mass upload of recurring journal entry templates

C. Available released APIs, migration objects, or public-cloud-compliant integration options

D. Recommended best practices followed by other customers facing similar requirements

Has anyone successfully implemented a scalable solution for this scenario in SAP Public Cloud?Any guidance, recommendations, or alternative approaches would be greatly appreciated.

Thank you in advance for your support.

entry.title: Own Application Log App
entry.content:
Hi,

we have our own app built on top of SAP BTP ABAP Environment.  The solution has own namespace e.g. /NS/ and it generates various application logs for our own application log objects like /NS/EXPORT. We want to provide own app where users can see individual application logs. We followed the following tutorial how to define own application log app using adaptation project. 

https://help.sap.com/docs/btp/sap-business-technology-platform/how-to-create-standalone-application-logs-tile

The app works fine when executed locally. When we try to deploy it as an app /NS/LOG, we get the following error during deployment.

The app uses not permitted services for ABAP for Cloud Development

We looked at the details of the message and the problem seems to be that our package is /NS/LOG is ABAP for Cloud Development (it must be) but the application log service has not been released for consumption. 

How are we supposed to deliver an app that users could use to preview application logs? There does not seem to be a generic app that could be used on SAP BTP ABAP Environment? Ironically, I was able to teach Claude Code to read the messages directly from the service without any issues.
